classification: Owner-approved refinement of the prototype port; existing presentation and workspace owners retained
acceptance: Implementation complete locally; owner review pending. No merge, push, task closure, or new image-baseline acceptance.

reference.approved_override: All-channel membership now means eligible channels from same-group inspector cards plus this Animation panel’s pins. Existing gestures, framing, typed edits, explicit visibility masks and shared history remain protected.

contract.following: Union of open inspector cards from all Parameters panels in the active workspace and same A–E group, including inactive tabs. Graph selection, card collapse and viewport scrolling do not define membership.
contract.pins: Per-Animation-panel, per-group workspace state; stable {network,node,parameter?,component?} selectors, independent of animation channel lifetime. Supports individual components and whole nodes.
contract.unpin: Returns to inspector-following, without deleting keys or changing history/framing.
contract.masks: Hide and Isolate remain explicit and independent; pins never override them.
contract.ownership: Workspace panel.state.inspectors remains authoritative; PanelContextRouter projects inspectorNodes. AnimationViewModel consumes explicit targets. No second membership registry, document state, effect-name switches or alternate edit path.
contract.internal_api_change: AnimationViewModel.networkId replaced by targets; projected channels carry networkId, nodeKey, parameter and component. All application/test callers migrated.
contract.shared_control: PinButton.qml extracts the accepted inspector pin glyph for both consumers; inspector accumulation pins and Animation visibility pins are separate.
contract.restoration_fix: Parameters and Animation rehydrate externally restored state even when panel IDs/bodies are reused, suppress feedback from their own state writes, and do not write stale state at teardown. Inspector initialization waits for Panel binding injection.

sanitizers.environment: ASan+UBSan+LSan; offscreen UI harness; existing issue70 fixed-Mesa environment and existing tests/lsan_suppressions.txt; no new suppressions
